name: L2 代码审查流程
description: L2 组长级代码审查流程，支持 AI 自动审查和人工审查
author: Pipeline-Sys

changed_files.description: 变更文件列表（逗号分隔），为空则自动检测

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: 'CR-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), task_id: inputs.task_id, reviewer: inputs.reviewer, started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 检测变更文件
nodes.description: 获取 commit 范围内的变更文件
nodes.command: if [ -n "${inputs.changed_files}" ]; then echo "${inputs.changed_files}" | tr ',' '\n'; else git diff --name-only ${inputs.commit_range} 2>/dev/null || git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD; fi

nodes.name: 获取变更内容
nodes.command: git diff ${inputs.commit_range} --unified=5 2>/dev/null | head -500 || git diff HEAD~1..HEAD --unified=5 | head -500

nodes.name: 准备审查输入
nodes.description: 构建 AI 审查的输入数据
nodes.expression: (() => { const files = (nodes.detect_changes.output.stdout || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20); const diff = (nodes.get_diff_content.output.stdout || '').slice(0, 5000); return JSON.stringify({ task_id: inputs.task_id, dimensions: inputs.review_dimensions, files: files, diff_preview: diff }); })()

nodes.name: AI 代码审查
nodes.description: 调用 cursor-agent 进行代码审查分析

nodes.name: 降级审查
nodes.description: AI 审查失败时使用默认评分
nodes.expression: ({ logic: 70, style: 70, security: 70, performance: 70, maintainability: 70, issues: [], suggestions: ['AI 审查失败，使用默认评分'], summary: '无法完成 AI 审查' })

nodes.name: 解析 AI 结果
nodes.description: 解析 cursor-agent 返回的 JSON
nodes.expression: (() => { try { const result = JSON.parse(nodes.ai_review.output.stdout); return { logic: result.logic || 70, style: result.style || 70, security: result.security || 70, performance: result.performance || 70, maintainability: result.maintainability || 70, issues: result.issues || [], suggestions: result.suggestions || [], summary: result.summary || '审查完成' }; } catch(e) { return { logic: 70, style: 70, security: 70, performance: 70, maintainability: 70, issues: [], suggestions: ['解析失败'], summary: '解析 AI 结果失败' }; } })()

nodes.name: 计算综合评分
nodes.description: 根据 AI 返回的各维度分数计算总分
nodes.expression: (function() { const weights = { logic: 0.30, style: 0.25, security: 0.20, performance: 0.15, maintainability: 0.10 }; const aiResult = nodes.parse_ai_result ? nodes.parse_ai_result.output : (nodes.fallback_review ? nodes.fallback_review.output : {}); const scores = { logic: aiResult.logic || 70, style: aiResult.style || 70, security: aiResult.security || 70, performance: aiResult.performance || 70, maintainability: aiResult.maintainability || 70 }; let total = 0; for (const [dim, weight] of Object.entries(weights)) { total += (scores[dim] || 70) * weight; } return { total_score: Math.round(total), dimensions: scores, issues: aiResult.issues || [], suggestions: aiResult.suggestions || [], summary: aiResult.summary || '', pass_threshold: inputs.pass_threshold, passed: total >= inputs.pass_threshold }; })()

nodes.name: 生成通过报告
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: nodes.intake.output.review_id, task_id: inputs.task_id, result: 'APPROVED', score: nodes.calculate_score.output.total_score, dimensions: nodes.calculate_score.output.dimensions, issues: nodes.calculate_score.output.issues || [], suggestions: nodes.calculate_score.output.suggestions || [], summary: nodes.calculate_score.output.summary || '代码审查通过', reviewer: inputs.reviewer, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 生成需修改报告
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: nodes.intake.output.review_id, task_id: inputs.task_id, result: 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', score: nodes.calculate_score.output.total_score, dimensions: nodes.calculate_score.output.dimensions, issues: nodes.calculate_score.output.issues.length > 0 ? nodes.calculate_score.output.issues : [{ severity: 'major', message: '总分未达到通过阈值 ' + inputs.pass_threshold }], suggestions: nodes.calculate_score.output.suggestions || [], summary: nodes.calculate_score.output.summary || '需要修改后重新提交', reviewer: inputs.reviewer, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

body.title: 代码审查跳过
body.msg:
task_id=${inputs.task_id}
reason=没有检测到代码变更
